about: Questions whose answer is in the report's own sections, with the passage that must be found (INFO/ANALYZE-NON-FIN-DATA-PLAN.md §11). 'must_find' is text in the passage's path and its first PDF page; checked against the pages on 2026-09-28. The ranking must put it in its top 30 (the selector's candidates); the keyword fallback should have it in the top 4 for at least 80% of the questions.
